subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if so should the canonical surface be a `tui.deliver` config key, a different config key, or a TUI-owned preference?
rationale: The missing capability is source-reproducible, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs frame delivery as an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve a config default
options.body: Add a narrow boolean delivery default through the canonical config/schema/help/docs/test path, with explicit CLI flags taking precedence.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Document the maintainer decision that delivery remains an explicit per-session flag and close or retitle the request accordingly.

options.title: Use a TUI preference
options.body: Reject a global config key and design a TUI-owned persisted preference or settings flow if maintainers want per-user behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve a config default
recommendation.body: Add a narrow boolean delivery default through the canonical config/schema/help/docs/test path, with explicit CLI flags taking precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mainly about OpenClaw config/default policy and current source ownership points to this TUI/config surface.
